data.text: **Question:** Explain advanced Entity Framework Core performance optimization.
EF Core optimization includes: compiled queries, split queries, no-tracking, batching, and proper indexing. Avoid N+1 queries and client-side evaluation.
Compiled queries cache query plans. Split queries avoid cartesian explosion. No-tracking improves read performance. Use projections to select only needed columns. Proper indexing is crucial.
